done_when: A worker's forge test runs only the tests the item names (or a bounded selection) when the selection is broad, says that CI runs the full suite, and a test proves a shared-fixture change no longer runs the full suite locally, on new and adopted repos

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Functional. The new worker bound leaves existing suite tests asserting the previous behavior, so full CI will fail. In tests/test_close_runs_only_related_tests.py:77–80, the shared-input cases call bare `forge test` and expect all six tests; this branch now runs only `test_changed`. In tests/test_lanes_tests.py:379–393, the `dirty-picker` case expects a failing related test and later the full suite. Its one-of-two selection is now broad, and neither test file was touched, so the command instead returns success without running tests. Update both proofs for the new contract, preserving dirty-source coverage with a selection below the broad threshold.
findings.title: Gate: existing worker-selection regression tests

why: A worker's forge test runs the whole suite when a shared test fixture changes (one change ran 3,190 tests for two hours on the laptop), because the broad-selection skip applies only at close
